format: UCWDC Finals, head-to-head, shared placements and carry-forward

source.quote_free_summary: Remaining ties are decided by win/loss/tie records from individual judges' marks with re-visitation; a final tie shares the placements actually tied (announced as the higher one); tied contestants carry forward the average of the shared placements.

requirement: A UCWDC engine must implement head-to-head with re-visitation, shared-placement announcement and the carry-forward average (Rule #8.4-#8.6).
enforcement_point: NOT IMPLEMENTED. A blocker to activating any future UCWDC scoring profile (OD-13). A future UCWDC engine must be independently verified, separately versioned (never by editing ordinal_rank@1 or studio_ordinal_majority@1) and evaluated under OD-24. Docs-only record: no compliance claimed.
interpretation_notes: Studio shares placements and skips numbering (2, 2, 4), which resembles Rule #8.4 only for entries still tied after Studio's shorter chain. Carry-forward averaging is not implemented for Studio.
decision_refs: OD-13 (owner decision 2026-11-23, Option A: preserve DanceFlow Studio scoring; retrospective audit PR #795)
